# 0.5.0 — Threat impact and leverage lists

23 September 2026. Minor on **0.4.0**.

`threat.impact` and `threat.leverage` are lists of vocabulary names, as `threat::1.0` specifies. 0.4.0 rejected every threat written to the spec with `Input should be a valid string`. A threat written the way 0.4.0 required (`impact: Data Breach`) now fails until it becomes a one-item list — update threats before upgrading a pipeline.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.5.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

Then run `opentide generate` so new threats start from the list template. If your CI patches the installed `opentide` model to accept lists, drop that step.

## Changed

- `threat.impact` and `threat.leverage` must be non-empty YAML lists of vocabulary names. A single string fails with `must be a YAML list of … vocabulary names`; a value or list item that joins several names with `;` fails too. Give every name its own item and keep all of them ([#189](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/189)).
- SDK: `ThreatBody.impact` / `.leverage` are `list[str]`. Threat templates, editor schemas (`type: array`, `minItems: 1`), and the explorer bundle carry lists ([#189](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/189)).

```yaml
threat:
  impact:
    - Data Breach
    - Identity Theft
  leverage:
    - Elevation of privilege
```

## Fixed

- Threats written to the `threat::1.0` spec validate, and `validate` no longer suggests a single vocabulary name for a `;`-joined value, which would drop the other names ([#189](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/189)).

## Tests

The 14 `threat-*.yaml` conformance fixtures from [OpenTideHQ/specifications](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/specifications) run through `opentide validate --file` in the E2E suite, and a guard fails when upstream adds one without an expectation ([#189](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/189)).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide setup --yes --name "Tutorial Detections" --org "Example Corp" --platform sentinel --path /tmp/tutorial-detections
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections generate
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections validate --strict
```

Expect `0.5.0`. The generated threat template (`.opentide/templates/threat.1.0.template.yaml`) lists `impact` and `leverage` as YAML lists.
